summary_1line: Arjuna saves Yudhishthira from Drona’s assault; later Drona plots to capture Yudhishthira by luring Arjuna away, and the Trigartas swear a deadly vow to challenge him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Drona fires two broad-headed arrows that sever the jeweled heads of Singhasena and Vyaghradatta from their chariots amid the chaos of battle.
Arjuna’s chariot thunders forward as the battlefield becomes a river of blood filled with broken chariots, weapons, and fallen warriors beneath a storm of arrows.
The Trigarta princes and allied kings stand around ritual fires in armor and kusa grass garments, swearing a solemn vow to kill or die fighting Arjuna.
